text:
Priya N: PR #501 is ready (migration guide updates + new SDK snippet). Preview deployed but noticed sitemap still lists old migration URLs and the social preview image (og:image) is showing a broken thumbnail. Targeting Tue maintenance merge 2026-05-26 01:00 UTC. Can infra + two reviewers sanity-check preview/CI?

Sam T: I can review. Which preview is acting up (Netlify or Vercel)? Sometimes the sitemap issue is from stale build cache.

netlify-bot: [auto] Deploy queued for PR #501 — preview: https://deploy-preview-501--redwood-docs.netlify.app — status: success (post-check: sitemap includes /migration-old, social meta present but image 404).

docs-bot: Docs CI: md-lint: pass; linkcheck: pass; sitemap-check: flagged outdated entries (1) — see CI artifact.

Priya N: It looks like our sitemap plugin didn't pick up the new slug because I renamed the page file. Also the og:image path is `/images/og-migration.png` but Netlify serves images from `/static/images/og-migration.png` in the built site. I missed updating meta template.

Sam T: Local repro steps I put in the PR comments that usually catch this:
```
# fetch PR branch
git fetch origin pull/501/head:pr/501
git checkout pr/501
# build mkdocs static site
pipenv install --dev
mkdocs build
# inspect generated sitemap
sed -n '1,200p' site/sitemap.xml | sed -n '1,80p'
# serve static output to mimic preview
python -m http.server --directory site 8080
# open http://localhost:8080 and view source for <meta property=\"og:image\"> 
```
If sitemap still contains old entries, check the page frontmatter (slug) and sitemap plugin config. For og:image, confirm the image is copied into `site/` at the expected path.

Alex P: Quick fix idea: update the meta template to use `{{ base_url }}images/og-migration.png` and copy the image into `docs/images/` so both Netlify and our static mirror will include it consistently. For sitemap, add an explicit `canonical` frontmatter on the renamed page so the plugin emits the right URL.

Priya N: Pushed branch `fix/sitemap-ogimage` with two edits: adjusted meta template, added `canonical` frontmatter to the migration page, and copied og image into `docs/images/`. Redeploying now.

netlify-bot: [auto] Redeploy finished — preview: https://deploy-preview-501--redwood-docs.netlify.app — status: success. Post checks: sitemap updated, og:image served at /images/og-migration.png.

Vercel Bot: [auto] Note: our Vercel mirror for this repo uses a different routing prefix. If you rely on absolute `/images/...` paths, Vercel previews may differ. Consider relative paths or including both locations during build.

Sam T: Reviewing the content changes. Left a tiny nit: in the JS SDK snippet, rename `client` to `redwoodClient` for clarity and include a one-line example call. Also asked for 2 approvals before merge.

Jordan F: Quick infra note: sitemaps are often cached by search crawlers and some preview checkers. The CI artifact regenerating sitemap is authoritative for the merge. We should avoid merging until sitemap-check CI passes on the final commit.

Priya N: Updated snippet name to `redwoodClient` and added example call. Pushed commit. Also re-ran `mkdocs build` locally and verified `site/sitemap.xml` shows only the new slug.

docs-bot: Re-run CI — all checks pass. sitemap-check: pass. linkcheck: pass. md-lint: pass.

Alex P: Approved. :white_check_mark: Content nit resolved.

Sam T: Approved. :white_check_mark: Verified sitemap and og:image locally via the static serve and in Netlify preview. Added a short local-checklist to the PR description for future contributors:
1) `mkdocs build` and check `site/sitemap.xml` for expected URLs
2) serve static output: `python -m http.server --directory site 8080` to confirm meta tags and images
3) run linkcheck and sitemap-check locally if possible (CI will also run it)
4) smoke-test code snippets in a REPL

Priya N: Thanks! Scheduling merge for Tue 2026-05-26 01:00 UTC maintenance window. Will merge in the window and post here when done. If anything flakey shows up post-merge (cache/sitemap propagation), I'll ping infra.

Jordan F: If you see crawler-related flakiness after merge, give it a few minutes and then trigger a sitemap reindex (infra can help). Also tagging infra channel FYI when merged.

Priya N: Merge completed in window. Release note added to PR: "docs: update migration guide slug, regenerate sitemap, and fix og:image path". Closing thread.

Sam T: Thanks everyone — added the local checklist to the docs contributing guide as a follow-up.
